# Margin

Margin is deadline-aware recovery automation for Amazon FBA sellers.

## Core Positioning

Margin turns Amazon loss events into claim-ready recoveries before time runs out. It detects reimbursement-worthy FBA activity, starts the claim clock, identifies the claim type, matches evidence, prepares recovery cases for seller review, and tracks recovery states from detection through payout.

## Trust Model

- Read-only first
- Seller approval before filing
- Weak, duplicate, unsupported, expired, or low-confidence cases held back
- No recovery commissions
- Amazon makes final reimbursement decisions

## Commercial Model

Margin opens access in controlled waves. Margin runs as a monthly recovery management system rather than a percentage-based reimbursement service. Sellers keep approved recoveries.
